lectures.title: How did oil paint make light glow? Van Eyck's Arnolfini Portrait
Can one beam tell a story? Caravaggio's Calling of Saint Matthew
How does light pick out a hero? Rembrandt's The Night Watch
What can one candle do? La Tour's Magdalen with the Smoking Flame
Why does window light feel so calm? Vermeer's The Milkmaid
Can a sunset say goodbye? Turner's The Fighting Temeraire
What if you paint the light, not the thing? Monet's Impression, Sunrise
Why paint the same church thirty times? Monet's Rouen Cathedral
Can dots make light? Seurat's A Sunday on La Grande Jatte
Can light be a feeling? Van Gogh's The Starry Night

quiz.question: A painter wants a velvet sleeve to look deep and glowing. Which follows Van Eyck?
choices: Mix the colour with lots of white
Thin coloured coats over a lighter underlayer
One thick coat of the brightest colour
A gold outline around the sleeve

quiz.question: A film director wants a scene in a crowded bar where a stranger silently picks one person. Which lighting follows Caravaggio?
choices: A spotlight on the stranger
A shaft from the door to one face
A lamp glowing behind the stranger
Even light over the whole bar

quiz.question: A theatre director stages a crowd scene and wants the audience to see at once who leads it. Which lighting follows Rembrandt?
choices: Even light on the whole crowd
A spotlight on the leader, the rest black
Leader lit from below, crowd evenly lit
Bright leader, a few lit helpers, the rest dim but visible

quiz.question: A stage director wants a scene where a man sits alone at night, deciding whether to forgive his brother. Which lighting follows La Tour?
choices: A hard beam from one high window
Soft daylight from a side window
Even light from all around
A lamp beside him that he stares into

quiz.question: A photographer wants a calm portrait of a baker at work. Which light follows Vermeer?
choices: Soft light from a window behind her
A bright window straight ahead of her
A candle on the table
Soft light from a side window

quiz.question: A film about a coal mine closing ends on the last shift walking home. Which light follows Turner?
choices: The last shift walks home under noon glare
The last shift walks home under stadium floodlights
The last shift walks home in grey drizzle
The last shift walks home into a setting sun

quiz.question: A photographer wants a foggy morning on a bridge the way Monet would paint it. Which follows his method?
choices: Crisp bridge, a hazy sky
Soft shapes, all in muted grey
Sharp focus on every bolt
Soft shapes, one bright colour

quiz.question: A photographer wants to do what Monet did in Rouen. Which project follows his method?
choices: Thirty trees at noon
One tree, thirty angles
One tree, one spot, all day
One perfect dawn shot

quiz.question: A mosaic maker wants a sunny wall to glow from across the square. Which follows Seurat?
choices: Tiles in pre-mixed colours
Black tiles for every shadow
Small tiles, warm and cool side by side
Small tiles of gold, grey in the shade

quiz.question: A photographer wants a night photo of a city that feels the way this sky does. Which follows Van Gogh?
choices: A sharp, still long exposure
Invented lights in a real street
The real lamps, swirled
One streetlamp on one face
